description: Remove location, camera and other hidden data. Lossless for JPEG, PNG and WebP; orientation is kept. HEIC and AVIF are re-encoded as JPEG, which can be bigger than the original. Writes a new file next to the input (name-clean.ext) unless output is given, never replaces a file unless overwrite is true, and returns the path, format and size change.

output.description: Where to write. Default: next to the input, like photo-resized.jpg

overwrite.description: Replace an existing output file. Default false

path.description: Absolute path (or ~/…) of the image to read: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or HEIC. HEIC is written as JPEG unless a format is chosen.

quality.description: Quality for lossy output (JPEG, WebP, AVIF), 1–100. PNG ignores it

name: remove_metadata
